observation: Channel shuffle has exact data-reordering semantics but different memory mappings. Historical CUDA.jl NHWC removes native shared staging; KA preserves a static shared tile, while JACC uses dynamic shared storage with an extra template initialization. These are observable source-level confounds, not evidence that one abstraction intrinsically requires more traffic. Both layouts retain native launch geometry for the named entry.
